name: talkflow
description: TalkFlow — free, talk-to-automate successor to n8n. Natural language first, AI does everything, $0 deployment.

scripts.build: echo [talkflow-build 1/6] llm-router && npm run build -w @talkflow/llm-router && echo [talkflow-build 2/6] db && npm run build -w @talkflow/db && echo [talkflow-build 3/6] connectors && npm run build -w @talkflow/connectors && echo [talkflow-build 4/6] prompts && npm run build -w @talkflow/prompts && echo [talkflow-build 5/6] api && npm run build -w talkflow-api && echo [talkflow-build 6/6] web && npm run build -w talkflow-web && echo [talkflow-build DONE]
